blocks.x: KYC Management System's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally KYC Management System is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.

items: health, throughput, cost and policy telemetry

blocks.x: Instrumented from week one, on your channels — KYC Management System edition:

Runtime dependencies: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for KYC Management System follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring KYC Management System architecture to a 45-minute briefing with the practice lead — your metric, our method, and an honest read on feasibility.
